correctness.rationale: The explicit edge-family equivalence is exhaustive. The independently rerunnable verifier checks all 12067 nonempty faces, 6021 acyclic matches, 25 critical cells, signed Morse matrices, their zero composition and a unimodular 4-by-4 minor. H6=Z^16, other reduced integral H vanish. Morse CW is simply connected, so Hurewicz and Whitehead promote to a wedge of 16 S6. No infinite extrapolation.

originality.rationale: The full result is an exact integral homotopy classification for M3(K6)=R4(KG(6,2)). The 2026 robust-clique primary treats bipartite square sequences, the 2020 Singh complete-graph theorem treats r=n-2 not r=n-3, and the 2013 Jonsson result gives torsion detection primarily for loop-admitting bounded-degree complexes. No indexed statement or accessible prior claim implies the sixteen-sphere homotopy decomposition. Residual unindexed-case risk is acknowledged.
residual_risks: Exact equivalent homotopy calculation may exist in an unindexed matching-complex table, monograph or unpublished computation.
Published rational homology work could already contain the numerical rank sixteen; no novelty is claimed for rank alone.

value.rationale: The first naturally submaximal complete-graph bounded-degree case is the missing r=n-3 neighbor of Singh’s complete r=n-2 classification, and is simultaneously a four-robust Kneser test case from the 2026 topology definition. A 12067-face complex collapses in the integral Morse sense to one circle-free CW model with exact sixteen six-sphere type; this is more structural than a field Betti computation and motivates a real next-order classification.
